questions.stem: A 45-year-old man is being evaluated for fracture union 8 weeks after sustaining a tibial shaft fracture. Which of the following is NOT a clinical sign of fracture union?

options.label: B
options.text: Presence of tenderness at the fracture site

options.label: C
options.text: Absence of free movement between the fractured fragments

options.label: D
options.text: Visible callus bridging the fractured site on X-ray
